transcript: The only time I've seen Titanic is when it was in a basement in a Gristedes in Chelsea. So I was so curious how a Celine Dion Titanic parody musical could possibly work at the Saint James Theater on Broadway. So, obviously, when I was invited to the final dress rehearsal before Titanic started previews, I had to go and find out for myself. I love invited dress. It is always such a good vibe. I got a little sneak peek at all of the new merch that everybody loves. Semen fan, please. The life jacket magnet. I need it. And then I got into the theater, and I was sitting in the very front row, dead center. We said hi to Paige. She's a lighting designer. She's a super star. And then it was time for the show. It's 90 minutes and no intermission. And I was just blown away by all of the upgrade. The set fills the stage. It feels kind of like a cruise ship, which works so well. The costumes feel upgraded. There are so many incredible props. Obviously, I'm obsessed with this lighting. There must be 70,000 lighting cues. This cast is so good and so funny. Marla is obviously the heart and soul of the show. Her vocals are incredible. Her comedic timing is everything. The improv scene tonight made me gasp and cry. But really, it's all of them. I love Melissa's Rose so much. She and Constantine had incredible chemistry. Layton As the iceberg on the ground, Deborah Cox got a deserved standing ovation. Jim Parsons made a Big Bang Theory joke. He was so silly, he made me giggle. There was a moment with John Riddle and Constantine where I was asping. And I will always and forever love Frankie Grande. The world is really hard right now, and to have a show where for 90 minutes you can just forget about it. You can walk into a theater and put your phone on airplane mode and just giggle. It cannot be underestimated the kind of joy that that brings. And I think we all need it. I'm losing my mind. What the hell? This is bringing joy back to Broadway, man. I really, really needed that. Anyway, technique is now in previews on Broadway. Go find that happiness and say hi to Celine in the lobby.
